traits.d: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
The wolf has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

The wolf exhales a blast of freezing wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: cold — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.
Слабый спасбросок: Интеллект (-2) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Тактика стаи — получает преимущество на атаку, если союзник рядом с целью. Не давайте себя окружать, разделяйте противников.
